scripts.build: turbo run --continue=dependencies-successful lint check-types build test && pnpm fallow:gate && pnpm check-types:scripts
scripts.ci:build: mkdir -p .turbo && turbo run --continue=dependencies-successful --concurrency=2 lint check-types build test --summarize=true --profile=.turbo/profile.json && pnpm check-types:scripts
scripts.fallow:gate: pnpm fallow:coverage && pnpm check-coverage-map && fallow audit --base origin/main && fallow dead-code && fallow dupes && fallow health --min-score 85
